<p class="source-citation"><a href="https://docs.ogc.org/is/18-062r2/18-062r2.html#toc35">Published source: OGC 18-062r2, 1.0.0 (toc35)</a>.</p>

<div id="ogc_process_description">
<span id="toc35"></span>
<p id="_611d191f-08fc-d649-eae1-8090d82a72ab">The following section describes the <tt>OGC Process Description</tt> requirements
class.</p>
<div id="_overview_2"><h2 class="published-heading" id="toc36">8.1.  Overview</h2><span id="rc_ogc-process-description"></span><!-- requirements-class -->
<p id="_18da7668-fd72-97d7-5355-947c265fe644">The OGC process description is an information model that may be used to specify the interface of a process.  This model is an evolution of the process description model originally defined in the <a href="https://docs.ogc.org/is/14-065/14-065.html">OGC WPS 2.0.2 Interface Standard</a> but also includes elements of the <a href="http://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.0.3">OpenAPI Specification</a>.  Specifically, this process description languages uses <a href="https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/json-schema-core.html">JSON Schema</a> fragments to define the input and output parameters of a process.  As such, this process description provides a bridge from legacy implementations to the OGC API Framework.</p>
<p id="_bfe0bde8-6763-b6f7-7e6d-a0fdbf139a7a">The process description allows the following information to be specified:</p>
<ul id="_4aba8fb2-4d89-e460-bb0a-eee6391f5269">
<li>
<p id="_14a0fae9-b1ee-9b27-14db-f24eb17e3d72">An identifier for the process</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="_4fdae1fa-10d9-d57e-93d5-404c99752e87">Descriptive metadata about the process;</p>
<ul id="_256af9ad-833e-0a8e-c39d-c5f513fb3fc4">
<li>
<p id="_604e51a7-40c0-a5f8-e69d-59ca69db09b3">A title</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="_cdfa0f0b-ad17-1b47-f6d1-2ccd829f32b1">A narrative description of the process</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="_3809019c-699d-2a98-1e82-c0f6ee03f2d1">Keywords that can be associated with the process</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="_25d08a6a-195a-e89b-bd99-e37388923f5e">References to additional metadata</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p id="_f02bff03-e815-67aa-689b-a365cf342f1b">A description of each process input specified using a <a href="https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/json-schema-core.html">JSON Schema</a> fragment.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="_18784e82-8154-d210-64b8-af6c44e1a26d">A description of each process output specified using a <a href="https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/json-schema-core.html">JSON Schema</a> fragment.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="_58a9ff36-0c3a-0ece-54be-13239561a854">A job control specification that indicates whether the process can be invoked synchronously, asynchronously, or either.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="_aac6732d-54a4-454a-1f55-ddcad466d19c">An output transmission specification that indicates how the results of a process are retrieved; either by value or by reference</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="_f3f2018f-53b7-63bb-3fb4-4254aa6e3cb9">A section for additional parameters that are intended for communities of use to extend the process description as required</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p id="_a666f282-c999-fdc3-bbab-0424ca52ef8c">The following clause defines a JSON-encoding of the OGC process description.</p></div>
<div id="_ogc_process_description"><h2 class="published-heading" id="toc37">8.2.  OGC process description</h2><span id="req_ogc-process-description_json-encoding"></span><!-- requirement: ogc-process-description/json-encoding -->
<pre class="prettyprint" id="_aa9b1e4b-9978-fcea-d7ce-d301ad0eb498">allOf:<br/>  - $ref: "processSummary.yaml"<br/>  - type: object<br/>    properties:<br/>      inputs:<br/>        additionalProperties:<br/>          $ref: "inputDescription.yaml"<br/>      outputs:<br/>        additionalProperties:<br/>          $ref: "outputDescription.yaml"</pre><p class="SourceTitle" style="text-align:center;">Figure 22 — Schema for a process</p>
<div class="Note" id="_136a70de-077c-3c2e-e3e3-0fbe44596e48"><p><span class="note_label">NOTE  1</span>  This schema can also be obtained from <a href="http://schemas.opengis.net/ogcapi/processes/part1/1.0/openapi/schemas/process.yaml"><tt>process.yaml</tt></a></p></div>
<p id="_439ca4fa-a012-ca77-3643-9a235e55dd53">(see also: <a href="#schema-processSummary"><tt>processSummary.yaml</tt></a>)</p>
<p id="_ca796f6b-8e70-1c8c-86a9-aabca565af4d">The schema imports the elements from the <a href="#schema-processSummary">process summary</a> and specifies an object for the definition of process inputs and another object for the definition of process outputs.</p>
<span id="req_ogc-process-description_inputs-def"></span><!-- requirement: ogc-process-description/inputs-def -->
<pre class="prettyprint" id="_b5e5b8bd-fcc7-9c97-1b29-f9adb2fedc1a">allOf:<br/>  - $ref: "descriptionType.yaml"<br/>  - type: object<br/>    required:<br/>      - schema<br/>    properties:<br/>      minOccurs:<br/>        type: integer<br/>        default: 1<br/>      maxOccurs:<br/>        oneOf:<br/>          - type: integer<br/>            default: 1<br/>          - type: string<br/>            enum:<br/>              - "unbounded"<br/>      schema:<br/>        $ref: "schema.yaml"</pre><p class="SourceTitle" style="text-align:center;">Figure 23 — Schema for a process input</p>
<div class="Note" id="_7920a84d-0106-5373-fe9f-95761f1c3288"><p><span class="note_label">NOTE  2</span>  This schema can also be obtained from <a href="http://schemas.opengis.net/ogcapi/processes/part1/1.0/openapi/schemas/inputDescription.yaml"><tt>inputDescription.yaml</tt></a></p></div>
<p id="_0aa55da0-7399-98af-03fb-8cf4a0e5768c">(see also: <a href="http://schemas.opengis.net/ogcapi/processes/part1/1.0/openapi/schemas/descriptionType.yaml"><tt>descriptionType.yaml</tt></a>).</p>
<span id="req_ogc-process-description_input-def"></span><!-- requirement: ogc-process-description/input-def -->
<div class="Note" id="_ddd1fde6-00ce-1cab-7822-b64b3a092072"><p><span class="note_label">NOTE  3</span>  The schema fragment specified as the value of the <tt>schema</tt> parameter can be used to validate the corresponding <a href="#input-value-schema">process input value</a> in an <a href="#execute-request-body">execute request</a>.</p></div>
<span id="req_ogc-process-description_input-binary"></span><!-- requirement: ogc-process-description/input-binary -->
<span id="req_ogc-process-description_input-mixed-type"></span><!-- requirement: ogc-process-description/input-mixed-type -->
<p id="_b3c68d62-11f7-9973-4823-738ee53904cf">The following JSON Schema fragment illustrates how to define an input of mixed type.  In this case, the <tt>imageInput</tt> input can be one of a couple of image media types.</p>
<pre class="prettyprint" id="_7bc96d67-445d-1714-8ab3-dd015c30a051">"imageInput": {<br/>  "schema": {<br/>    "oneOf": [<br/>      {<br/>        "type": "string",<br/>        "contentEncoding": "binary",<br/>        "contentMediaType": "application/tiff; application=geotiff"<br/>      },<br/>      {<br/>        "type": "string",<br/>        "contentEncoding": "binary",<br/>        "contentMediaType": "application/jp2"<br/>      }<br/>    ]<br/>  }<br/>}</pre><p class="SourceTitle" style="text-align:center;">Figure 24 — Mixed type input example</p>
<table class="recommend" id="rec_ogc-process-description_format-key" style="border-collapse:collapse;border-spacing:0;"><thead><tr><th class="recommend" colspan="2" scope="colgroup" style="vertical-align:top;"><p class="RecommendationTitle">Recommendation 17</p></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td class="recommend" colspan="2" style="vertical-align:top;"><p>/rec/ogc-process-description/format-key</p></td></tr><tr><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">A</td><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">
<p id="_685622cc-bfd8-a9f8-31b0-5e886d204465">Servers SHOULD use the <tt>format</tt> key in the schema description of a process input or output (key: <tt>schema</tt>) to provide additional semantic context that can aid in the interpretation and validation of process input or output values in an <a href="#sc_create_job">execute</a> request.</p>
</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p id="_697af3fb-4ae5-4ef2-35d5-d9e3f022e18b">The <a href="#jsonschemavalidation">JSON Schema specification</a> defines a <a href="https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/json-schema-validation.html#rfc.section.7">set of values</a> for the <tt>format</tt> key.  This specification extends this list by defining the following additional key values for use specifically in OGC process descriptions.</p>
<p class="TableTitle" style="text-align:center;">Table 13 — Additional values for the JSON schema format key for OGC Process Description</p><table class="MsoISOTable" id="format-key-values" style="border-width:1px;border-spacing:0;"><thead><tr><th scope="col" style="font-weight:bold;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle;border-top:solid windowtext 1.5pt;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.5pt;">Key value</th><th scope="col" style="font-weight:bold;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle;border-top:solid windowtext 1.5pt;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.5pt;">Short code</th><th scope="col" style="font-weight:bold;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle;border-top:solid windowtext 1.5pt;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.5pt;">Description</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:solid windowtext 1.5pt;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">
<a href="http://www.opengis.net/def/format/ogcapi-processes/0/geojson-feature-collection">http://www.opengis.net/def/format/ogcapi-processes/0/geojson-feature-collection</a>
</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:solid windowtext 1.5pt;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">geojson-feature-collection</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:solid windowtext 1.5pt;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">Indicates that the object is an instance of a GeoJSON feature collection <a href="http://schemas.opengis.net/ogcapi/features/part1/1.0/openapi/schemas/featureCollectionGeoJSON.yaml">(featureCollectionGeoJSON.yaml)</a>.</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">
<a href="http://www.opengis.net/def/format/ogcapi-processes/0/geojson-feature">http://www.opengis.net/def/format/ogcapi-processes/0/geojson-feature</a>
</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">geojson-feature</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">Indicates that the object is an instance of a GeoJSON feature <a href="http://schemas.opengis.net/ogcapi/features/part1/1.0/openapi/schemas/featureGeoJSON.yaml">(featureGeoJSON.yaml)</a>.</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">

</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">geojson-geometry</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.0pt;">Indicates that the object is an instance of a GeoJSON geometry <a href="http://schemas.opengis.net/ogcapi/features/part1/1.0/openapi/schemas/geometryGeoJSON.yaml">(geometryGeoJSON.yaml)</a>.</td></tr><tr><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.5pt;">
<a href="http://www.opengis.net/def/format/ogcapi-processes/0/ogc-bbox">http://www.opengis.net/def/format/ogcapi-processes/0/ogc-bbox</a>
</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.5pt;">ogc-bbox</td><td style="text-align:left;vertical-align:middle;border-top:none;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.5pt;">Indicates that the object is an instance of an OGC bounding box <a href="http://schemas.opengis.net/ogcapi/processes/part1/1.0/openapi/schemas/bbox.yaml">(bbox.yaml)</a>.</td></tr></tbody><tfoot><tr><td colspan="3" style="border-top:0pt;border-bottom:solid windowtext 1.5pt;"><div class="Note" id="_1100c4cf-f416-7f1e-2e31-5b4ba2501546"><p><span class="note_label">NOTE</span>  This list of values has been submitted to the <a href="https://www.ogc.org/projects/groups/ogcnasc">OGC Naming Authority</a> for registration in their definition server.</p></div></td></tr></tfoot></table>
<table class="recommend" id="rec_ogc-process-description_additional-format-short-code" style="border-collapse:collapse;border-spacing:0;"><thead><tr><th class="recommend" colspan="2" scope="colgroup" style="vertical-align:top;"><p class="RecommendationTitle">Recommendation 18</p></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td class="recommend" colspan="2" style="vertical-align:top;"><p>/rec/ogc-process-description/format-short-code</p></td></tr><tr><td class="recommend" colspan="2" style="vertical-align:top;"><p id="_b301d350-4c6f-afe1-3484-c16b9dc211a1">In addition to the key values listed in <a href="#format-key-values">Table 13</a>, servers SHOULD also accept the short codes.</p></td></tr></tbody></table>
<p id="_a3388ed0-2e4a-4b0a-878f-7c6f52b26685">Situations might arise where communities of interest wish to extend this list of values for their own purposes.</p>
<table class="recommend" id="rec_ogc-process-description_format-value-registration" style="border-collapse:collapse;border-spacing:0;"><thead><tr><th class="recommend" colspan="2" scope="colgroup" style="vertical-align:top;"><p class="RecommendationTitle">Recommendation 19</p></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td class="recommend" colspan="2" style="vertical-align:top;"><p>/rec/ogc-process-description/format-value-registration</p></td></tr><tr><td class="recommend" colspan="2" style="vertical-align:top;"><p id="_c7aad1ad-881d-8003-bfe4-179950a21095">Servers wishing to extend this list of <tt>format</tt> key values, SHOULD officially register such values with the <a href="https://www.ogc.org/ogcna">OGC Naming Authority</a>.</p></td></tr></tbody></table>
<p id="_1322ead6-aa53-c47d-7d25-c8e8edca6b40">The following JSON Schema fragment illustrates the use of the <tt>format</tt> key to include a semantic hint to a process input that is a geometry.</p>
<pre class="prettyprint" id="_61a22b1c-cdfe-15f7-5162-996babd25db7">"geometryInput": {<br/>  "title": "Geometry input",<br/>  "description": "This is an example of a geometry input.  In this case the geometry can be expressed as a GML of GeoJSON geometry.",<br/>  "minOccurs": 2,<br/>  "maxOccurs": 5,<br/>  "schema": {<br/>    "oneOf": [<br/>      {<br/>        "type": "string",<br/>        "contentMediaType": "application/gml+xml; version=3.2",<br/>        "contentSchema": "http://schemas.opengis.net/gml/3.2.1/geometryBasic2d.xsd"<br/>      },<br/>      {<br/>        "allOf": [<br/>          {<br/>            "format": "geojson-geometry"<br/>          },<br/>          {<br/>            "$ref": "http://schemas.opengis.net/ogcapi/features/part1/1.0/openapi/schemas/geometryGeoJSON.yaml"<br/>          }<br/>        ]<br/>      }<br/>    ]<br/>  }<br/>}</pre><p class="SourceTitle" style="text-align:center;">Figure 25 — Example of semantic hints using the format key</p>
<pre class="prettyprint" id="_cbd269b7-08ac-1258-6385-ccd78f20f871">allOf:<br/>  - $ref: "descriptionType.yaml"<br/>  - type: object<br/>    required:<br/>      - schema<br/>    properties:<br/>      schema:<br/>        $ref: "schema.yaml"</pre><p class="SourceTitle" style="text-align:center;">Figure 26 — Schema for a process output</p>
<div class="Note" id="_1b168944-9043-9a6f-f90a-a3129e60ae2f"><p><span class="note_label">NOTE  4</span>  This schema can also be obtained from <a href="http://schemas.opengis.net/ogcapi/processes/part1/1.0/openapi/schemas/outputDescription.yaml"><tt>outputDescription.yaml</tt></a></p></div>
<p id="_68bd9f48-320c-5a9c-6c26-23dacc646aab">(see also: <a href="http://schemas.opengis.net/ogcapi/processes/part1/1.0/openapi/schemas/descriptionType.yaml"><tt>descriptionType.yaml</tt></a>).</p>

<p class="SourceTitle" style="text-align:center;">Example  — Example OGC Process Description.</p><div class="example" id="_443805da-dfcc-84bd-1820-4a41a69f629a"><p id="_523a0733-1ae9-cb7a-019c-e56ae5f73937">The following URL is an example of retrieving a <a href="#sc_process_description">process description</a> from the <tt>/processes/{processID}</tt> endpoint.</p>
<pre class="prettyprint" id="_04682a59-2b97-7a72-b498-4a5361b464ce">https://processing.example.org/processes/EchoProcess</pre>
<p id="_45db4353-53ef-8af8-76dd-907d2fcba16f">The description of the example <tt>EchoProcess</tt> process might be:</p>
<pre class="prettyprint" id="_63c89a5c-96a0-a5f8-4828-a27784b3c906">{<br/>  "id": "EchoProcess",<br/>  "title": "Echo Process",<br/>  "description": "This process accepts and number of input and simple echoes each input as an output.",<br/>  "version": "1.0.0",<br/>  "jobControlOptions": [<br/>    "async-execute",<br/>    "sync-execute"<br/>  ],<br/>  "outputTransmission": [<br/>    "value",<br/>    "reference"<br/>  ],<br/>  "inputs": {<br/>    "stringInput": {<br/>      "title": "String Literal Input Example",<br/>      "description": "This is an example of a STRING literal input.",<br/>      "schema": {<br/>        "type": "string",<br/>        "enum": [<br/>          "Value1",<br/>          "Value2",<br/>          "Value3"<br/>        ]<br/>      }<br/>    },<br/>    "measureInput": {<br/>      "title": "Numerical Value with UOM Example",<br/>      "description": "This is an example of a NUMERIC literal with an associated unit of measure.",<br/>      "schema": {<br/>        "type": "object",<br/>        "required": [<br/>          "value",<br/>          "uom"<br/>        ],<br/>        "properties": {<br/>          "measurement": {<br/>            "type": "number"<br/>          },<br/>          "uom": {<br/>            "type": "string"<br/>          },<br/>          "reference": {<br/>            "type": "string",<br/>            "format": "uri"<br/>          }<br/>        }<br/>      }<br/>    },<br/>    "dateInput": {<br/>      "title": "Date Literal Input Example",<br/>      "description": "This is an example of a DATE literal input.",<br/>      "schema": {<br/>        "type": "string",<br/>        "format": "dateTime"<br/>      }<br/>    },<br/>    "doubleInput": {<br/>      "title": "Bounded Double Literal Input Example",<br/>      "description": "This is an example of a DOUBLE literal input that is bounded between a value greater than 0 and 10.  The default value is 5.",<br/>      "schema": {<br/>        "type": "number",<br/>        "format": "double",<br/>        "minimum": 0,<br/>        "maximum": 10,<br/>        "default": 5,<br/>        "exclusiveMinimum": true<br/>      }<br/>    },<br/>    "arrayInput": {<br/>      "title": "Array Input Example",<br/>      "description": "This is an example of a single process input that is an array of values.  In this case, the input array would be interpreted as a single value and not as individual inputs.",<br/>      "schema": {<br/>        "type": "array",<br/>        "minItems": 2,<br/>        "maxItems": 10,<br/>        "items": {<br/>          "type": "integer"<br/>        }<br/>      }<br/>    },<br/>    "complexObjectInput": {<br/>      "title": "Complex Object Input Example",<br/>      "description": "This is an example of a complex object input.",<br/>      "schema": {<br/>        "type": "object",<br/>        "required": [<br/>          "property1",<br/>          "property5"<br/>        ],<br/>        "properties": {<br/>          "property1": {<br/>            "type": "string"<br/>          },<br/>          "property2": {<br/>            "type": "string",<br/>            "format": "uri"<br/>          },<br/>          "property3": {<br/>            "type": "number"<br/>          },<br/>          "property4": {<br/>            "type": "string",<br/>            "format": "dateTime"<br/>          },<br/>          "property5": {<br/>            "type": "boolean"<br/>          }<br/>        }<br/>      }<br/>    },<br/>    "geometryInput": {<br/>      "title": "Geometry input",<br/>      "description": "This is an example of a geometry input.  In this case the geometry can be expressed as a GML of GeoJSON geometry.",<br/>      "minOccurs": 2,<br/>      "maxOccurs": 5,<br/>      "schema": {<br/>        "oneOf": [<br/>          {<br/>            "type": "string",<br/>            "contentMediaType": "application/gml+xml; version=3.2",<br/>            "contentSchema": "http://schemas.opengis.net/gml/3.2.1/geometryBasic2d.xsd"<br/>          },<br/>          {<br/>            "allOf": [<br/>              {<br/>                "format": "geojson-geometry"<br/>              },<br/>              {<br/>                "$ref": "http://schemas.opengis.net/ogcapi/features/part1/1.0/openapi/schemas/geometryGeoJSON.yaml"<br/>              }<br/>            ]<br/>          }<br/>        ]<br/>      }<br/>    },<br/>    "boundingBoxInput": {<br/>      "title": "Bounding Box Input Example",<br/>      "description": "This is an example of a BBOX literal input.",<br/>      "schema": {<br/>        "allOf": [<br/>          {<br/>            "format": "ogc-bbox"<br/>          },<br/>          {<br/>            "$ref": "../../openapi/schemas/bbox.yaml"<br/>          }<br/>        ]<br/>      }<br/>    },<br/>    "imagesInput": {<br/>      "title": "Inline Images Value Input",<br/>      "description": "This is an example of an image input.  In this case, the input is an array of up to 150 images that might, for example, be a set of tiles.  The oneOf[] conditional is used to indicate the acceptable image content types; GeoTIFF and JPEG 2000 in this case.  Each input image in the input array can be included inline in the execute request as a base64-encoded string or referenced using the link.yaml schema.  The use of a base64-encoded string is implied by the specification and does not need to be specified in the definition of the input.",<br/>      "minOccurs": 1,<br/>      "maxOccurs": 150,<br/>      "schema": {<br/>        "oneOf": [<br/>          {<br/>            "type": "string",<br/>            "contentEncoding": "binary",<br/>            "contentMediaType": "application/tiff;
